what: When the mouse brushes a card, it gets nudged and spun by the direction and speed of entry, then returns to place — cursor movement per frame ×30 is thrown as x·y velocity (±1080), torque between cursor and center ×20 as rotation speed (±60), and resistance 200 brings it to rest at 0

options.xy: Cursor speed → push speed multiplier, default 30
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Bounce area (photos, stickers). Inside it [data-fx-part=If target] is present, only that moves (name tag and shadow stay put)
options.duration: When fixing the inertia length (seconds), no default (uses resistance)
options.least: Even on a slow swipe, bounce by this share (relative to the cap), and also check the path passed every 4px so skipped sections are hit too — default 0 (off)

from.where: shared.js momentum (team photo·handwritten sticker collage [data-momentum] — original data-momentum-hover-init, xy 30 · rotation 20 · resistance 200)

shared.js header logo seven letters (xy 6.6 · max 237.6 · rotation 96 · spinmax 300 · duration .5 · least .6), footer wordmark (xy 20 · max 720 · rotation 16 · spinmax 50 · duration .6 · least .6), index.html stars and eyes (xy 20 · max 720 · rotation 16 · spinmax 50) — original momentum: speed×20 clamped to ±720 and torque×16 clamped to ±50, then per-element xy·rotation multipliers (logo .33·6)
